modern: Whatever anyone does or says, I must be good; just as if gold, or emerald, or purple were always saying this: Whatever anyone does or says, I must be emerald and keep my colour.

explained.summary: Whatever anyone else does or says, your job is to be good. Marcus pictures an emerald saying, whatever happens around me, I must be emerald and keep my colour. Goodness is your nature, not a response to how others behave, so other people’s conduct is no excuse to lose it.
explained.today: When a customer is rude, or a relative is being impossible at a family gathering, you can stay courteous and kind, not because they’ve earned it but because that’s who you are.
